title: Blåhaj [StationAPI]
description: Adds Blåhaj shark plush toy from IKEA. Can be held, placed on blocks and in bed to cuddle while sleeping. For BETA 1.7.3.
body:
# Blåhaj STAPI
Simple port of [Blåhaj mod](https://github.com/Hibiii/Blahaj) for Minecraft **Beta 1.7.3** and StationAPI. 

Adds stuffed shark a.k.a Blåhaj from IKEA.

![Blahaj and Steve](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d379ba108e8f27b64ed3e53485d271fdd12b81fd.png)

**Blåhaj** can be held, placed on blocks and in bed to cuddle while sleeping (hitbox in bed is buggy tho).

![Blahaj crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c323348def6312b384ae7a63a9490c9d9f025a4e.png)

Simple crafting with light blue wool, white wool and pink dye. 

## Required dependencies

- **[StationAPI](https://modrinth.com/mod/stationapi)**

## Compatibility

- No known issues.
